meta.summaryLong: Pages come from MD YAML. Papers from the catalog/DB. Nodes from diagram JSON meta. Boards from Open on iPad. Code from @chunk after seed. Modules are curated rows in persist/meta.ts. Same schema — not a second bus.

data/meta/schema.json: required id, type (page|paper|node|module|diagram|board|code), title, summary.short/long, tags, citations, related, glossary, updated. Optional pageId, paperIds, implements, derived_from, board fields, code kind/path.
listMeta assembles all writers. Filters: q, type, tag, citation, related. GET /api/meta/:id loads one record (aliases allowed). GET /api/tools lists these routes.
metaAsHits prepends ground=meta records. boostByMeta nudges other hits by title/tags. No cross-ground RRF. Ask returns citations plus citeOrFetch (mustCite, notInDb → POST /api/papers/fetch).
Node click looks up node:<diagram>:<id> and shows summary.long plus page/paper links. Open on iPad POSTs pageId, paperIds, related, citations onto a clean or stamped board.
